display.title: The Time of Our Freedom: Preparing for Pesach and the Final Geulah
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi explains why Pesach is 'the time of our freedom', why shmurah matzah strengthens body and soul, and how trust in Hashem brings the final Geulah.
display.summary_long: A Pesach talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, recorded about ten days before the holiday. Uncle Yossi explains 'Zman Cheiruseinu', the time of our freedom: as one of the Twelve Pesukim teaches, in every generation we must see ourselves as if we left Mitzrayim today. The Arizal taught that when we remember the miracles with firm trust in Hashem, they happen again in our own times. He reviews the preparations: food and wine for Yom Tov, selling the chametz before Pesach, and enough shmurah matzah for the two Seder nights. The Zohar calls matzah food of faith and food of healing, strengthening the neshamah and the body for the whole year. Strong emunah brings Moshiach closer, and the coming Geulah will be the final one, with no golus after it. A saying of the Frierdiker Rebbe makes the point: we ask not for many salvations but for one lasting one. The talk ends with 'L'shanah haba'ah b'Yerushalayim'.
display.lesson: Strengthen your trust in Hashem as Pesach comes: it brings the miracles of the past into our own days and hastens the final Geulah.
